description: This file defines interfaces, classes, enums, and constants related to Content Decryption Module (CDM) and Encrypted Media Extensions (EME) for DRM, including session management, key handling, encryption schemes, and system factory pattern.

classes.name: BufferReader
classes.description: A utility class for reading various data types from a byte buffer, supporting endian correction and stream position management.

classes.name: IMediaKeySessionCallback
classes.description: Callback interface for media key session events such as key message creation, errors, and key status updates.

classes.name: IMediaKeySession
classes.description: Interface for managing a media key session, including loading, updating, removing, closing, and decrypting media data.

classes.name: IMediaKeySessionExt
classes.description: Extended interface for media key sessions with additional DRM-specific functions like setting headers and challenge data.

classes.name: IMediaKeys
classes.description: Interface for creating and managing media key sessions, setting server certificates, and destroying sessions.

classes.name: IMediaKeysExt
classes.description: Extended interface for media keys with DRM system time, secure stop, and store management functions.

classes.name: IMediaSystemMetrics
classes.description: Interface for retrieving media system metrics.

classes.name: IMediaSessionMetrics
classes.description: Interface for retrieving media session metrics.

classes.name: ISystemFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating media key system instances, with initialization and deinitialization methods.

classes.name: SystemFactoryType
classes.description: Template class implementing ISystemFactory for specific media key system implementations.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Template method for reading multi-byte data types from the buffer with endian correction.

methods.name: HasBytes
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has enough bytes remaining for a read.

methods.name: IsEOF
methods.description: Checks if the end of the buffer has been reached.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns size of the buffer.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Returns current read position in the buffer.

methods.name: Read1
methods.description: Reads a uint8_t value from the buffer.

methods.name: Read2
methods.description: Reads a uint16_t value from the buffer.

methods.name: Read2s
methods.description: Reads an int16_t value from the buffer.

methods.name: Read4
methods.description: Reads a uint32_t value from the buffer.

methods.name: Read4s
methods.description: Reads an int32_t value from the buffer.

methods.name: Read8
methods.description: Reads a uint64_t value from the buffer.

methods.name: Read8s
methods.description: Reads an int64_t value from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadString
methods.description: Reads a string of specified length from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadVec
methods.description: Reads a vector of bytes of specified length from the buffer.

methods.name: Read4Into8
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte uint32_t and stores it into a uint64_t.

methods.name: Read4sInto8s
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte int32_t and stores it into an int64_t.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Advances the read position by specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetHeight
methods.description: Returns stream height.

methods.name: GetWidth
methods.description: Returns stream width.

methods.name: GetMediaType
methods.description: Returns media type of the stream.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves media key session metadata.

methods.name: CreateMediaKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new media key session.

methods.name: SetServerCertificate
methods.description: Sets the server certificate for media keys.

methods.name: DestroyMediaKeySession
methods.description: Destroys a media key session.

methods.name: GetDrmSystemTime
methods.description: Retrieves DRM system time.

methods.name: GetVersionExt
methods.description: Retrieves extended version info.

methods.name: GetLdlSessionLimit
methods.description: Retrieves LDL session limit.

methods.name: IsSecureStopEnabled
methods.description: Checks if secure stop is enabled.

methods.name: EnableSecureStop
methods.description: Enables or disables secure stop.

methods.name: ResetSecureStops
methods.description: Resets secure stops.

methods.name: GetSecureStopIds
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop IDs.

methods.name: GetSecureStop
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop data.

methods.name: CommitSecureStop
methods.description: Commits secure stop data.

methods.name: DeleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes key store.

methods.name: DeleteSecureStore
methods.description: Deletes secure store.

methods.name: GetKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves key store hash.

methods.name: GetSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves secure store hash.

methods.name: Metrics
methods.description: Retrieves media system or session metrics.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of media key system.

methods.name: KeySystem
methods.description: Returns the key system identifier.

methods.name: MimeTypes
methods.description: Returns supported MIME types.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the system factory with shell and config.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the system factory.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables the media key system.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the media key system.
